title: Voice control and navigation UI
summary: Feedback on voice control and related UI centers on unreliable recognition and awkward operation, with only limited clearly positive comment about convenience.

positive.summary: The only clearly positive review praises the voice recognition and panel operation as fitting the BMW character.

negative.summary: Negative reviews describe persistent problems with voice control and Alexa and strongly dislike the touch and voice control interface.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined fragments mention both convenience and multiple recognition, menu navigation, clarity, and usability issues, but the sample is too ambiguous to summarize as a single clear sentiment.

limitations: Most sampled fragments are labeled undetermined, which limits confidence in a clear sentiment read.
Several undetermined fragments contain sentiment-like wording that cannot be reassigned, so the topic evidence is internally inconsistent.
The topic combines voice control, voice recognition, navigation voice, and broader UI/control comments, which are related but not identical subjects.
